items.title: Complete Video Item Creation Flow
items.description: User creates a new item with video content from start to finish, representing the primary use case for the workflow

steps.action: Select 'Kitchen' room from the room grid
steps.expectedResult: Kitchen room card shows selected state, navigation enabled
Appliance card selected, proceeds to specific item step

steps.action: Choose 'Coffee Machine' from suggestions or enter custom name
steps.expectedResult: Item name auto-generated as 'Kitchen - Coffee Machine'
Content source set, proceeds to content type selection
Camera interface activates for video recording
Video captured, thumbnail generated, proceeds to preview
Item saved successfully, success toast displayed

steps.action: Select 'I'm Done' at next action prompt
Review session summary with created item
steps.expectedResult: Item listed with thumbnail and QR code

items.expectedOutcome: Item saved with video content, QR code generated and visible in session summary

items.title: Create Item with Uploaded Photo
items.description: User uploads an existing photo for an item instead of creating new content
preconditions: Has photo file ready on device
items.expectedOutcome: Item created successfully with uploaded photo content

items.title: Create Item with URL Content
items.description: User creates an item by pasting a URL (e.g., YouTube instruction video or manufacturer manual)

steps.expectedResult: URL preview fetched with title and thumbnail

items.expectedOutcome: Item created with URL content, Open Graph preview displayed

items.title: Create Text-Only Item for General Info
items.description: User creates a general information item with text instructions (e.g., WiFi password, house rules)

steps.expectedResult: General room selected, item type step may be skipped

steps.action: Enter WiFi network name and password

items.expectedOutcome: General info item created with text content

items.title: Create Multiple Items in Single Session
items.description: User creates multiple items in sequence using 'Tag New Item' option

steps.action: At next action, select 'Tag New Item'
At next action, select 'Tag New Item'

items.expectedOutcome: Session summary shows all 3 created items with QR codes ready for printing

items.title: Handle Camera Permission Denied
items.description: System gracefully handles when user denies camera permission for video recording

steps.action: Navigate to content creation with 'Record Video' selected
Deny camera permission in browser prompt

steps.expectedResult: Options to retry, upload instead, or go back shown
File picker opens for video upload

items.expectedOutcome: User can still complete item creation by uploading video instead of recording

items.title: Handle Network Error During URL Preview
items.description: System handles network failure when fetching URL metadata

steps.expectedResult: Loading state shown while fetching preview
Error state displayed with retry option
URL saved without preview, warning displayed

items.expectedOutcome: User can proceed with URL content despite preview fetch failure

items.title: Handle Empty Session Exit
items.description: Confirm dialog shown when user tries to exit without creating any items

steps.action: Start workflow and progress to any step
Dialog shows 'No items created yet' message

steps.expectedResult: Dialog closes, user remains in workflow

items.expectedOutcome: User is warned before accidentally losing an empty session

items.title: Handle Duplicate Item Name
items.description: System handles attempt to create item with duplicate name

steps.action: Select Kitchen room and Appliance type
Previously created item shown grayed out
User can edit name manually if desired

items.expectedOutcome: Duplicate names are automatically handled with incremental suffix

items.title: Session Recovery After Browser Refresh
items.description: Session state is preserved and recoverable after accidental browser refresh

steps.action: Start workflow and complete 3 steps (room, type, item)

steps.expectedResult: Room, type, and item selections intact

items.expectedOutcome: User can continue from where they left off without data loss

items.expectedOutcome: Long names are truncated consistently with full text accessible via tooltip
